title: Terrifier 4
overview: The fourth installment in the Terrifier franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Demonte Colony 3
overview: Srini and Debbie set out to find a missing librarian, but their search soon leads them into a dark and mysterious world. As they uncover hidden secrets, they find themselves unraveling a sinister mystery far more dangerous than they imagined

title: The Ascent
overview: Wedding guests at a European resort face terror when their celebration turns into a life-or-death struggle high above dangerous waters teeming with sharks.

title: Black Tides
overview: Rebecca reunites with her estranged father, Bill, in sunny Málaga expecting a healing family trip with her young son, Sebastian. Instead, their voyage across the Strait of Gibraltar becomes a nightmare as they’re relentlessly attacked by rogue orcas. Rebecca, confronting deep emotional wounds, must rise as an unlikely hero in a battle for survival.

title: Mycardiumopathy
overview: An experimental documentary that explores heart muscle disease and the impact a diagnosis can have on a young person’s outlook on life.

title: Marble Tears Taste Like Wine
overview: A volatile chess prodigy struggling with anger management attempts to navigate a world that feels hostile, dismissive, and chaotic. While chess offers him control and identity, real life repeatedly provokes his buried rage. After fleeting moments of connection and hope, a final altercation spirals into irreversible violence, forcing him to confront the devastating cost of losing control.

title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
overview: A young man from Tanah Karo who becomes a central figure in Indonesia’s independence struggle. Born in 1921 and educated under Dutch rule, Djamin joins Gyugun with hopes of freedom, only to realize true sovereignty must be fought for. Alongside Likas Tarigan, he leads brilliant guerrilla tactics in North Sumatra while torn between devotion to family and unwavering duty to his homeland.

title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
overview: In a dilapidated apartment drowned in the oppressive hum of electricity, a man kills his evenings by watching, through a hole in the wall, an empty stage bathed in childish music. This strange routine brings him a fragile joy.  But one evening, something appears: an egg-shaped object marked with a face. An enigmatic presence. An angel… God?

title: Rostam
overview: A night in ancient Persia, full of demons, vampires, jinn, and heroes, after the world has been plunged into darkness. The creatures of the night feed on the living and bask in the victory, but something is coming for them, and he will not stop.

title: The Iris Protocol
overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

title: FAMILIAR
overview: A little girl and her mother look through an old photo album when a disturbing presence ruins the moment.

title: Friend, not that way!
overview: Franco and Julian, two childhood friends, grew up immersed in the world of reality TV and streaming. However, everything falls apart when they get caught up in a street fight instigated by others, causing them to lose money, damage their reputation, and jeopardize their friendship. The situation is further complicated by the arrival of Almendra, a mutual friend who sets off a chaotic love triangle.

title: Now, I See
overview: When a mysterious bicycle accident restores the sight of Simon, a 21-year-old who has been blind his entire life, his miracle comes with an unsettling catch. A cryptic message leads him to a door only he can see, where a secret organization offers him permanent vision at an unimaginable cost: his eyes will become live-streaming cameras, sacrificing his privacy in the name of a "safer world." Forced to choose between the gift of sight and his freedom, Simon must decide what he is truly willing to see.

title: THE BOX
overview: Living alone in an isolated rural cabin, Max’s quiet routine is disturbed when a mysterious wooden box appears on his doorstep containing an old photograph of his home. After throwing it away, the box inexplicably returns  and with it comes a series of increasingly disturbing events. As Max begins to realise he may not be alone, he finds himself caught in a sinister cycle that has haunted the cabin long before he arrived.

title: The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull
overview: "The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull" explores —through the editing of social media footage— the collective act of touching public statues, particularly on their intimate parts, and everything this gesture reveals about contemporary culture.

title: The Last Whale Singer
overview: When a monstrous creature escapes from a melting iceberg, a self-doubting teenage humpback whale must face his greatest fears and dive into the darkest depths with his friends, to discover the mystical song that can save the oceans from destruction.

title: Narciso
overview: Paraguay, 1958. The charismatic Narciso returns from Buenos Aires with rock ’n’ roll in his veins. Under the suffocating military regime, his radio show becomes a music sensation and a symbol of freedom.

title: Nomad Shadow
overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: The Umbrella Fairy
overview: Qing Dai, a royal umbrella fairy, fails her mission to guard a sword fairy who escapes the royal pavilion seeking vengeance. This leads her on a journey with a young craftsman to prevent a war.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview: Reluctantly sent to a summer retreat for young cancer survivors, a teenager in remission unexpectedly finds deep connections and new beginnings among fellow campers.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Untitled Cat Commercial
overview: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

title: Deadsight
overview: A cold-blooded contract killer known only as Deadsight executes without hesitation in order to clear his criminal record.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Corrupted Pleasure
overview: A corrupted file seduces the viewer

title: Ownerships
overview: Vera and Lucas, a frustrated couple in their forties, find a huge apartment at half the usual price thanks to a “bare ownership” deal: they buy it now, but the elderly owner will keep living there until he dies. What seemed like a miraculous opportunity soon turns into an obsession when Jesús disappears, reappears changed, and stops behaving like someone on his last legs. Caught between suspicion, frustration, and increasingly dark humor, the couple begins to consider a plan as absurd as it is tempting.

title: The Murder of Benjamin
overview: On a cold night in Holmlia, 15-year-old Benjamin is murdered by 19-year-old Joe Erling Jahr in a racially motivated assault. A year later, Benjamin's mother, Marit, faces her son’s killer in court.

title: XY9
overview: Mar and Iván see parenthood as a possible answer to the fractures in their relationship. As repeated miscarriages and genetic problems complicate that hope, the couple must confront what they are asking a child to repair, and whether their shared future can survive the weight of that desire.

title: Greeley's Creamies
overview: A mysterious snack cake brand leads its victims into a deadly parallel world if they stop consuming it.

title: Pre-Parenting
overview: Shu-Han uses augmented reality glasses to get a head start on parenthood. When a car crash claims her unborn daughter and embeds a lens fragment in her brain, she begins to see the child everywhere.

title: Chameli Ko Poi
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Intensive Purposes
overview: An ex-Chronoforce agent starts his reign of terror by freeing notorious killer Vianna Liang from her interdimensional prison. When their friend is killed, Jet Hikoki and Flex Ramos must survive their journey to save reality.

title: The True Spirit
overview: The story begins with the boxing lives of two urban Indigenous youths, Liu Li-Chen and Su Jing-Wen. Gifted with exceptional talent, Li-Chen won a national championship in junior high school, only to fall into confusion after entering high school—caught between boxing, academic expectations, and his Indigenous identity. As he struggles to find his path, his performance in the ring declines, dealing a heavy blow to his confidence. Jing-Wen, from the Nanjing Indigenous community in Sanxia, New Taipei City, is seen as a promising Olympic boxer of her generation. Yet deep down, she is uncertain about her future in boxing. The only reason she continues training is the weight of others’ expectations. Despite growing up in an urban Indigenous community, she finds no real sense of belonging in the city.

title: A Special Day
overview: A seemingly normal family home movie is interrupted by a shocking event.

title: NAZA
overview: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

title: Despedirse
overview: After a tragic event, Noah must take a road trip to say goodbye.

title: Al mal tiempo
overview: A man reflects on his entire existence while searching for a place to die.

title: ROSARIO ORTEGA, CARRER SANT RAMON 9, 08001 BARCELONA
La Nit del Foc
overview: It's all chaotic. Children are shouting, playing, making a mess, eating whatever they want, and making the world their own. Not an adult voice is heard disturbing the madness. It's San Juan, the night of fire was yesterday, but the party continues... What happened? Where are the parents? With a few shots and four drawings, the film evokes the most perverse and funniest childhood fantasies.

title: What Can't Be Mentioned
overview: Jackie is a social worker in training picking at the knots of her own unresolved issues.

title: Two Minutes, One Cup
overview: After a sudden break-up, the hungry Maggie falls in love sooner than she expects...

title: Loser Lesbian Vampire
overview: Carmilla is a vampire with a hopeless crush on Laura, an effortlessly cool writing major. To cope, Carmilla throws herself into toxic distractions: hooking up with a Mormon closeted lesbian whose blood tastes like repression, and murdering men (even though she finds masculine blood absolutely revolting.) Torn between hunger and heartbreak, Carmilla's unlife is spiraling. But obsession, like immortality, is hard to kill.

title: Creation
overview: The Hungarian word "alkotás" (artwork) has a dual meaning – it can refer both to the process of creation and to the finished artwork. The film tells the story of how a canvas comes alive, how playful, abstract forms are created, each one carrying its own human narrative.

title: Princess of the Murder
overview: Princess of the Murder is a campy, self-aware horror comedy that blends outrageous humor with over-the-top scares. It’s a story about cruelty, transformation, and the monstrous side of revenge—all wrapped in a delightfully ridiculous Halloween package. Balancing dark themes with absurd fun, the film delivers both chills and laughs, celebrating the spirit of B-movie horror while offering a tragic yet twistedly empowering tale.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.

title: The weight of water
overview: A guy, who just woke up, has to face the tough reality of water weight.

title: Takkuuk
overview: Takkuuk is an Inuktitut word meaning to be attentive or to look closely. It is often used to describe the environmental and cultural changes in the Arctic. In the film of the same name, we meet musicians and researchers from the Arctic who explore life, communities, and the challenges they face.  The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

title: Run Koala Run
overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

title: Wherever the wind takes us
overview: Two balloons realises that they both want different things out of their short lives, but they don't want to do it without each other.

title: D3STRO
overview: A young couple shares a deep passion about food and desire for each other. They put all their efforts to satisfy all their fantasies, until they come with the ultimate culinary experience. One must be eaten and the second must feed from the other’s flesh.

title: Grave Danger
overview: A grave robber is terrorized while looting corpses in a cemetery.

title: The "All-Nighter"
overview: Jace and Eli do their long awaited "All-Nighter", while Eli keeps a secret buried waiting to be cracked open

title: Overt Listening
overview: Hong Kong–born artist Tiffany Sia confronts the Cold War legacy of China in this landscape film shot amidst the serene environs of Taiwan’s Kinmen archipelago. On this stretch of land only 1,800 meters from the coast of China, deserted beaches and abandoned military bunkers and training facilities harbor echoes of past conflict, such as the 1949 Battle of Guningtou, in which Taiwan defeated the Chinese Communist Party and maintained control of the land.

title: Phone Wallet Keys Door
overview: There’s fifteen minutes until Cal’s going to call the uber. Henrietta’s still doing her makeup, Bridget’s trying on everyone else’s clothes, and Josie only just got home from shift. Whose house party are we going to again?

title: LOUF
overview: In his debut feature documentary, Aziz Zoromba follows acclaimed chef Fadi Kattan and Canadian co-venturer Nicole Mankinen as they race to open a Palestinian restaurant in Toronto. While their dream takes shape, escalating attacks devastate Gaza and the West Bank. Part immersive food film and part urgent record, LOUF is a powerful meditation on diaspora, resistance, and the politics of preservation.

title: Kappo
overview: An animation that follows a pair of legs in high heels striding forward with unwavering determination.

title: When Anyone Sees
overview: Christian, a young man overlooked by society, burdened by a dark past and escalating madness, finds himself trapped in a world of violence and despair.

title: Travel Reminiscence
overview: At a London community centre, facilitators and volunteers run a travel-themed session for people living with dementia and their families, friends and carers.  Together, the group embarks on a playful journey: discussing past trips, revisiting these through theatre, and writing postcards to loved ones.

title: One More Time
overview: André Gregory has been a pillar of the American avant-garde stage and film world for more than half a century. Now in his early nineties, Gregory shows no sign of slowing down, as evidenced by this delightful, enormously moving document of his inextinguishable creative spark. Directed by his partner of 25 years, Cindy Kleine, One More Time follows Gregory as he and two longtime creative collaborators, actors Larry Pine and Gerry Bamman, decide to film a reading of scenes from Samuel Beckett’s absurdist, apocalyptic Endgame—a play they’ve produced together multiple times over the decades—in Pine’s Long Island home.

title: A Stolen Movie
overview: Camilo Restrepo reappropriates and remixes a real General Motors promotional film depicting an early-1960s exhibition across the Darién Gap in Chevrolet Corvairs. As the representatives of the global North’s industrial might bridge the same chasm that stands between today’s migrants and the United States, Restrepo considers the unequal flows of people and property between the Americas.

title: A note on the ruins for visitors
overview: A note on the ruins for visitors is a deeply personal portrait of the Assyrian community from fragments of material drawn from Bahto’s family history, ancient artifacts, and collaborations with contemporary artists working across the diaspora. “When Daesh invaded Iraq and released videos of themselves destroying ancient Assyrian artworks in the Mosul Museum,” Bahto explains, “I found myself thinking more deeply about my relationship to history as the grandchild of survivors of Seyfo – the Assyrian genocide. In fact, I realized that the genocide hadn’t ended.” The film investigates the materiality of cultural memory alongside its personal and spiritual dimensions, embodying the rebuilding of a community and connection to culture that honors the past while insisting on an open future.

title: Sand Roads
overview: SAND ROADS is a journey told in two chapters - one filled with the spirit of youth; the other imbued with the weight of adulthood - showing the eternal struggle for self-discovery, adventure and how friendships can transcend life itself.

title: NYRA II
overview: Trapped in a series of looping dream timelines, Nyra is hunted by an unknown killer and must find a way to escape before the cycles consume her.

title: Click Clack, Front & Caps
overview: On the drive home from a night-long hotel party, Eve finally gets a moment alone with the crush she’s kept secret for years, her brother’s best mate, and shoots her shot.

title: Dead End
overview: A young father makes a migration decision without notifying his relatives, creating tense moments in the family. Concurrently, several body found cases in town remind him about the memories of his father’s death long past and gone, urging him to suspect that his family is trying to hide something from him…

title: Land of Shadows
overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

title: Ria
overview: 25-year-old Ria lives in a punk commune facing demolition with her diabetic foster mother. Working as a hotel housekeeper, she becomes entangled in underground porn operations as financial pressures mount.

title: Don't Bring A Knife To A Gun Fight
overview: Vito Tucco is testifiying against the prosecution. The Charge? Murder. His case gets slowly revealed as the prosecutor digs deeper an deeper

title: Motherland
overview: Patria I is a medium-length film by Juan Ibarlucía and Magela Crosignani that reimagines the form of the Baroque oratorio within the post-industrial landscape of Argentina in 2026. Drawing on a south american reinterpretation of the myth of Cain, and employing music, poetry, performance, and installation art, the work takes the audience on a powerful sonic and emotional journey that spans an extraordinary range of human experience—from extreme violence to compassion and tenderness.

title: Sapiens
overview: Na Do-han, a man with Dissociative Identity Disorder, shares his body with four different identities. One dawn, he wakes up in a motel with blood-soaked hands and the word 'Run!' scrawled on a mirror. Soon linked to the disappearance of a wealthy corporate heir, Do-han becomes the prime suspect. Concurrently pursued by corporate lawyer Seo Hee-jae, he must interrogate his own identities, each concealing a secret.

title: PAN DE AJO
overview: Victor, a shy and anxious guy, goes to Gabriel's apartment for the money he owes him. When he opens the door to Gabriel's room he will find nothing but horror...

title: Thicker Than Water
overview: Two estranged best friends find a way to reconnect after they discover a regenerative wine and begin testing its limits on each other.

title: Fan Out
overview: Chaos ensues when four university students accidentally submit fanfiction for a major assignment. What follows is an attempt to break into the lecturer's office and delete the file, a spontaneous mission which gradually spirals into mayhem.

title: The House Call
overview: Called in the middle of the night to treat a sick horse, a young equine veterinarian is faced with a series of unlikely encounters.

title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes
overview: Young participants in Escuela Dentro Cine make a collective visual alphabet, using self-filming and the image of clouds to explore freedom, rebellion and their own ways of seeing.

title: Tumbleweed
overview: A mysterious stranger enters an unknown tavern. There he must accept his fate.

title: Shaving
overview: Three years after escaping an abusive relationship, Suyeon retreats to her father's rural mansion to rebuild her life, writing horror fiction by day. When her caring boyfriend Shinji arrives for the holidays, a strange cut from a rusted razor sets something in motion. Something that wears his face but isn't him anymore. Isolated, with nowhere to run, they can no longer tell nightmare from reality as something begins to hunt them down.

title: Dreadful Mother
overview: Victoria awakens with a broken arm in a country house after being kidnapped. A doctor and nun care for her, but as she gradually uncovers their secrets, she realizes things aren't what they seem.

title: Little Happy Pills
overview: A young woman tries to keep a steady balance between her expectations, desires and personal life, however, her emotions and everyday routine keep getting in her way.

title: When people ask where you're from
overview: Sonja Aigner, born in South Africa and now living in Germany, reflects on identity and belonging after a DNA test reveals connections across the world.Through a quiet and intimate conversation, the film explores what it means to come from a place and whether that answer is ever complete.

title: GOR
overview: WHAT IF YOU GET TO ESCAPE  2 individuals from different state are stuck in a reality they can't escape while they encounter their own something vicious

title: Man Wearing a Helmet
overview: As Aboriginal boys are stolen from their families and brought to a rural mission, astonishingly visceral and discomforting truths about our collective past emerge.

title: La muerte de Drácula
overview: Through a story that combines horror, humor and fantasy, the film starts with the disappearance of Bram Stoker's mythical vampire to discover what happens when one of history's greatest monsters ceases to exist and its legacy passes into the hands of a new generation.

title: Pets on a Train
overview: When a train unexpectedly starts up, taking only pets with it, the animals discover that Hans, a badger with a grudge is behind it all. While the crash seems inevitable, the animals can count on Falcon, a roguish Raccoon who will do anything to save them.

title: The Magic Faraway Tree
overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: Blind Ants
overview: In 1935, a storm caused an English ship carrying coal to run aground in Bizkaia. Residents of Algorta gathered to rescue the coal, but Sabas Jauregui ignored their pleas and dragged his children into the storm.

title: Her Private Hell
overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: Arriba Tutto
overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

title: Escape Room 2
overview: Beneath Montjuïc, four people are trapped in an old tunnel, and a countdown of sixty minutes begins. Each second that passes tests what they will risk to get out, and whom they will trust along the way.

title: Perla
overview: Vicente Espinel is a folk musician struggling to preserve tradition in a world increasingly dominated by reggaeton. His life changes when he crosses paths with Perla, a bold and magnetic urban artist. Their connection sparks a clash between heritage and innovation.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: Untitled Ahaan-Aneet-Mohit Suri Film
overview: An upcoming Ahaan-Aneet-Mohit Suri film.

title: The Journal: Starting From Research
overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

title: The Girl We Let In
overview: Following the adoption of their longtime babysitter, 16 year old Sophie, Hope begins to suspect her new daughter is hiding a terrible secret that will endanger her family.

title: Petros Eni
overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

title: Cosmic Trace
overview: Hyeonji, an assistant producer for a YouTube channel, and Jihyeon , a struggling actor, continue living together while grappling with anxieties about the present and the future. When Hyeonji's father dies suddenly and Jihyeon's mother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, they find themselves overwhelmed.

title: My Body is a Prison
overview: Conner brings his pillow to life

title: Throw Away the Lover
overview: The only son of an Azerbaijani vampire family brings the girls he is in a relationship with home to meet his family.

title: Justice
overview: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

title: HOW TO UNMASK A FCKN INCEL?
overview: Matías, an introverted young man and rock music enthusiast, agrees to go out with his roommate, Hugo, unaware that they'll end up at a gay nightclub. There, he tries to connect with Gloria and fit into an environment that feels foreign to him, but his insecurities, prejudices, and social awkwardness lead to a series of uncomfortable situations. When Celine confronts him about his attitude toward women, Matías is forced to confront an image of himself he had never questioned.

title: The Form and the Silence
overview: Pushed by the precision of a demanding rehearsal, a young actress navigates the quiet tension between who she is and who she feels she needs to be.

title: El murmullo del agua
overview: During a birthday party, Luca, a sensitive and lonely boy, begins to feel out of place among the other children. As tensions rise, he takes refuge in the fantasy of being a mermaid, imagining a place where he can breathe.

title: A Few of Shakespeare's Days of Despair
overview: Unable to write for a long time, William Shakespeare embarks on a desperate search for inspiration. But everything he encounters forces him to confront his own legacy and creative burnout.

title: Dragon
overview: In a stagnant mountain pool, A-Mao fishes for a hidden giant lizard, dragging others into a bloody, infectious madness. Paralyzed and numb, his broken husk crawls back to the murk. At his physical limit, can this eerie desire drive his will to transcend the flesh?

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Un castello
overview: Martin is a boy who lives a tormented love for Karin, a girl who instead seems to want nothing more than to escape from him, until she gets sick and remains under the boy's care.

title: Yugen
overview: When the rain refuses to sleep and the sky forgets its peace, a girl born of pottery searches for the last mythical giant, hoping to save her fragile world.

title: Ringos Tally
overview: Set in the Arizona Territory in 1882, Ringo’s Tally follows infamous outlaw Johnny Ringo as he rides alone through the desert, hunted by the law, haunted by his enemies, and slowly losing control of himself. Drunk, exhausted and stranded after losing his horse, Ringo follows a distant firelight to a lonely campsite, where he meets a mysterious stranger carrying a dime novel written about his life.

title: Out.
overview: A look into a boy’s weeklong trip with his family as he tries to tell them something. Is he ready? Are they?

title: A Touch of Love
overview: A haunted-house sleeper arranges a hookup in a haunted house, only to encounter the ghosts of a married couple from the 1980s. Can one night of passion overcome a century of loneliness?

title: Dependence
overview: Even as a child, Grace Harper Brighouse was always filming her family. Now faced with her father’s death, Grace returns to this personal archive to piece together an unflinching account of his struggle with addiction to opioids and the impact it had on them. Dependence is a bold excavation of the things we hide to protect the ones we love.

title: The Golden Years of Dario Argento
overview: An in-depth interview with the master of giallo, Dario Argento, about his career and his masterpieces: from The Bird with the Crystal Plumage (1970) to Insomnia (2001).

title: The Catcher
overview: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds. One day he defies his orders and makes one dangerous choice.

title: Currents
overview: 4 strangers follow completely different paths through the same day. Leading them all to meeting at a beach party filled with chaos, drama, and action.

title: Biophilia
overview: When a brilliant botanist is pushed to the brink by his emotionally abusive husband's emotional abuse, he synthesizes a custom hallucinogen designed to force his tormentor to viscously experience his his own abuse first hand.

title: Where the Rain Nests
overview: In a rural town in southern Chile, three teenage friends spend their final months before finishing high school, facing a future that could pull them away from the place where they grew up.

title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

title: Frank and Percy
overview: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

title: When the World Stood Still...
overview: During the COVID-19 pandemic, while the world came to a standstill, a group of teenagers began building a Minecraft server. What started as a simple world to play in slowly grew into a universe of kingdoms, characters, timelines and stories.  Years later, the people behind Elementia look back on the world they created, the memories they made, and the unexpected ways a generation found connection and creativity during a time of isolation.

title: The Piano Tuner
overview: Trapped in a lonely marriage, Antonia finds unexpected connection when a mysterious piano tuner named Angelo arrives. As music awakens old memories and hidden truths, a quiet afternoon leads to a life-changing decision.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Zahartzaro feministarantz, Boga-boga
overview: A Basque documentary that highlights the 30-year history and collective empowerment of Boga-Boga, a feminist group for older women in Ondarroa, Basque Country. It focuses on the voices and lived experiences of older women, proposing an active and collective view of aging.

title: Why Andorra?
overview: With a sense of adventure and curiosity, we explore the micro-country of Andorra to understand how it has become one of the safest and most peaceful locations in the world.

title: Dendam Arwah Penari
overview: A terrifying horror from the past returns to haunt the present. When the spirit of a dancer comes seeking vengeance, no one knows who will be the next victim.

title: Aplikasi Iblis
overview: A mysterious app called "I Let You In" claims to connect users with spirits. After losing his lover to murder, Arya tries to find answers to his love's fate through the app, but it turns out the spirit he connects to isn't his lover's, but rather a malevolent entity exploiting Arya's grief to exact revenge.

title: The Book of Dreams
overview: After his wife’s death, Bolot raises his daughter Kyial, who once defeated cancer. But the illness returns, and there is almost no time left. When he learns about her secret diary of wishes, Bolot decides to take Kyial out of the hospital and fulfill every one of her dreams. Joining them on this journey is Kyial’s best friend, Joki — a grown man on the autism spectrum, who in his own way helps them endure the pain and rediscover the value of every single day.

title: Seven Days of Happiness
overview: Prokopiy, a 27-year-old boy with developmental disabilities, lives with his strict mother, Maria, who keeps him locked away for his own "safety." Life goes on as usual in a remote Yakut village until Prokopiy's cheerful sister, Aiyyna, arrives next door. She gives him warmth, attention, and a sense of "normality," and a simple, pure friendship blossoms between them, which becomes a revelation for the boy. Aiyyna leads him out of his locked room, takes him on a sleigh ride to a party, and for the first time makes him feel part of the outside world. But the closer Prokopiy gets to freedom, the more conflicts he has with his mother, who fears losing control and may not be able to protect her son from the pain society can inflict on him. A touching, harsh, and poetic coming-of-age story about a man who emerges from the safety of a locked world to an ambiguous freedom.

title: 10 Days Apart
overview: To save their fading love, a couple chooses ten days of silence, writing letters instead of speaking. On the final day, he discovers she was fighting a battle alone and loving him more than he ever knew.

title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet
overview: Based off the Wattpad Series by PRNCSPLM the third book in the series following The Both Sides Of Me. The last and final year of Junior High in 10 Sapphire everything changes when Chase's Ex Mackzyn transfers in his school and his section.

title: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport
overview: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport is a Thriller/Horror story based off the Wattpad Webstory by PRNCSPLM also known as Chase Pulumbarit, adapted by Aliah Dela Cruz.

title: Agata the Writer
overview: Agata travels from Sydney to Sarajevo to write a war novel, but as she gathers material, she is challenged by locals who question her motives. Her creative uncertainty growing, she sees a startling mystery unfold: some provocative and obscene artworks inexplicably vanish. As Agata reads the first chapters of her new novel, it becomes clear that the story is not about the war itself, but about the quiet, very human moments of resilience that persist in its shadow. During her stay in Sarajevo, Agata has developed a deeper understanding of the act of storytelling and the profound responsibilities that come with being a storyteller.

title: Home Sweet Home
overview: Struggling to find his place during his first year at university, a lonely international student finds comfort in an unexpected conversation that reshapes the way he perceives home and belonging.

title: Quick Fix
overview: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

title: new folk song
overview: A journey poem of freedom, as Toronto inhabitants harness public space for their own purposes.

title: Espresso
overview: Set in LA 2015, we follow the rise of an actor, Andrew Thompson, during a chemistry read for an upcoming superhero movie, while falling in love in the process with his soon-to-be co-star.

title: Longing
overview: Jack and Sofie arrive in London, ostensibly to explore whether they should move there together. As they walk the city and imagine a shared life in it, Sofie confesses: she's already decided. She quit her job.

title: The Pain Department
overview: A short documentary that follows the specialist pain team at a leading hospital in Western Ukraine as they treat soldiers injured in the war using the latest medical techniques.

title: Poetrix
overview: "POETRIX" (2026) is a short art experimental animation that was inspired by the dystopian novel "The smudge" (Taxideftis, 2021). It is about the interaction of conscious and subconscious, how the subconscious is formed in the course of life and can affect our actions and consequently the world. It all begins with a nightmare that triggers a repressed trauma to resurface and brings the main character "The Creature" face to face with itself.

title: The Patch
overview: "The Patch" (2026) is a short art animation that was inspired by the short illustrated story "The Patch" (Ioulia Lymperopoulou, Kondyli, 2025). It is an allegoric narration about resilience through change in life and about our inner child that needs to be nurtured and protected to be happy and creative.

title: Eye for an Eye
overview: A scavenger in a post-apocalyptic combine attempts to flea their tyrannical leader's control, but will her sister (their leader) let her

title: After The Freeze
overview: In the wreckage of a messy divorce, a single-mother poet finds her world upended when her first love resurfaces after twelve years, forcing her to choose between the safety of her new life and the passion of her past.

title: Visa Versa
overview: A German expat in Madrid helps her undocumented best friend with her citizenship, but not in the way either of them expected.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Nightborn
overview: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Exorcism Chronicles: The Beginning
overview: When a demonic uprising threatens to end the world as they know it, a monk and an excommunicated priest join forces to protect a powerful young boy and the next generation of magic. As dark forces close in, the unlikely trio must confront their inner demons.

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Poetic License
overview: Liz, a former therapist and soon-to-be empty nester, becomes the unexpected point of tension between two inseparable best friends and college seniors, Sam and Ari. Liz is forced to re-examine her life as the boys' friendship unravels in a fierce competition for her affection.

title: Chopin, a Sonata in Paris
overview: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.

title: And
overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.

title: Yalla Parkour
overview: In her relentless pursuit of a memory that reinforces her sense of belonging, Areeb crosses paths with Ahmed, a parkour athlete in Gaza, sparking a journey where conflicting aspirations intersect. Nostalgia meets with ambition, and the weight of a confined past meets with an unpredictable future.

title: Mother's Day
overview: In a tiny Indigenous Mexican town where everyone is family, a secret pregnancy tests the forbidden love between two cousins. During the vibrant Mother’s Day festival, a public dance becomes a bold act of defiance that will change their lives forever.

title: The Bad Son
overview: Rubén, an eleven-year-old boy, lives in a rural area with his father until he suddenly disappears. In the aftermath, Rubén moves in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows and with whom he must learn to coexist. In a setting where time seems to have stood still, their relationship gradually reveals a family history shaped by wounds passed down from one generation to the next. As Rubén grows older, he tries to understand this emotional legacy and find a way to break the cycle, confronting his past in an attempt to heal what he has inherited.

title: La maleta
overview: Laura and Nacho meet on a flight, but their brief encounter ends when they pick up their bags. Laura proposes a game, revealing the suitcase belongs to terrorists.

title: The Pension Heist
overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

title: The Observer
overview: A UFO mystery/thriller inspired by The Twilight Zone. Plot TBA.

title: Sheep in the Box
overview: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

title: STRANGE NEIGHBORS
overview: Between vast industry and hidden gems of untouched nature, STRANGE NEIGHBORS unfolds a wordless cinematic journey that reveals the silent, profound connection binding two seemingly opposite worlds.

title: Monster Mia
overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

title: A Day Through My Eyes
overview: Four stories reveal the truth about the lives of people with disabilities and autism, highlighting the importance of acceptance and compassion. Two schoolboys struggle to find their place in the new school, the city shows injustice in environmental accessibility, and work becomes a test of human dignity. Friendship demonstrates how even small steps can change the world. Through quiet observation, Marios comes to the conclusion that real change begins when we look at the world with other eyes - eyes full of struggle, where each struggle makes us wiser and closer to one another.

title: #Untitled Sangeeth Shobhan - Palnati Surya Pratap Project
Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: The Next Day
overview: During a birthday weekend at a summer house, a group of longtime friends gather to celebrate, laugh, and relive old memories. As the night unfolds, an unexpected moment shifts the emotional balance of the group, leaving one of them silently confronting an experience he does not fully understand.

title: Superfly
overview: Coming Soon

title: Your Silent Face
overview: A man in a seemingly stable relationship hides a private world of fantasy that slowly takes over his life. When a third presence appears, he is forced to confront what his addiction has done to intimacy, love and his own sense of self.

title: Lāu Tsa-Pôo (Before We Say Goodbye)
overview: Two 60-ish Taiwanese men share ambiguous closeness, built on ritual and obscurity in an old local bathhouse. Amidst a near-death accident, the body offers a final confession, revealing a lifetime of repressed desire that surfaces only when time runs out.

title: The Broken Voice
overview: Letters, diaries and secrets left by its protagonists, historical and prior unknown materials revisit the life and death of Federico García Lorca, one of Spain’s most beloved and internationally recognized poets.

title: Aa Bata Aama 2
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: The Story Of Dr Dolittle
overview: Jeanette Dolittle ( Pink Pinkett Jones)  is a young teenager who discovers that she has inherited the extraordinary ability to communicate with animals. As she learns to understand the voices of pets, farm animals, and wildlife, she forms a special bond with a scruffy terrier wearing a pink collar and heart-shaped tag. Together, Jeanette and her animal friends embark on their first adventure, learning that helping animals can change lives. This film serves as the origin story of Jeanette's journey.

title: Red Dirt
overview: When Emma Bennett, a teen girl living in the South, finds out life changing news, she has to find a way to navigate it with the help of her best friend Oliver, all while keeping it a secret from her step brother, Jake.

title: Portrait of a 21 Year Old Woman
overview: A few moments in the life of a young woman, torn between her daily boredom, her secret torments, and her memories of the past.

title: river man
overview: As a homeless alcoholic struggles through withdrawal, haunting memories and creeping paranoia blur the line between reality and delusion

title: Ya nos veremos por ahí
overview: During their graduation party, Óscar wants to let María know he has feelings for her before they go on separate ways. However, his escalating fear of rejection threatens to ruin his last chance.

title: Mundos para lelos
overview: A couple, after being rejected for a threesome, use a time machine to change the answer.

title: Cancer-Soul
overview: Hardly anyone remains untouched by the topic of cancer – whether through their own diagnosis or through a loved one. CANCER SOUL  opens a new perspective on cancer. Courageous. Holistic. And never told like this before. The film views cancer not only as a medical diagnosis, but as a complex interplay of body, mind and soul. Renowned cancer experts, doctors, alternative practitioners, energy healers and former patients speak openly about questions that concern many people:  Why does cancer develop?  What role do emotions, lifestyle, and environment play?  What treatment and support options are available – both conventional and holistic?  What can give people hope in these times?  CANCER SOUL combines modern medicine with new perspectives from naturopathy, psycho-oncology, biomedicine and spiritual approaches.  A film that doesn't pretend to have all the answers – but opens up new ways of thinking.

title: Angel & Meow
overview: A meta-cinematic odyssey where the boundaries between a composer's studio and a sci-fi galaxy dissolve through the power of music and an unlikely friendship.

title: 3650 Days
overview: When Madeline and Damien's eyes meet on a night out, their paths rapidly intertwine in a whirlwind of passion. Time stops as their realities intersect. Frozen in time, their futures meld as they dance with the chance encounter. Can two strangers find eternity in a night?

title: Fists and Chips
overview: Holly and Three Bellies battle over a bag of chips to discover nothing is worth more than being alive.

title: Vienna: Suddenly an Angel
overview: When 2½-year-old Vienna Savino passed away suddenly, her parents, Dr. Denise Wunderler and Dr. Michael Savino, were left with no explanation. As physicians, they had spent their careers saving lives, yet nothing prepared them for losing their own daughter to Sudden Unexplained Death in Childhood (SUDC) - a little-known tragedy that takes the lives of seemingly healthy children without warning. Determined to find answers, they turned their grief into action.

title: The Interview
overview: Four strangers on their way to a job interview get stuck in a lift. They share their trauma, only to discover that the interview has already begun.

title: The Comfort Dogs of Uganda
overview: Former child soldiers and their rescued dogs learn to heal together.

title: Two Prayers
overview: A Muslim man seeks a new place to pray, leading him to the local church.

title: Like Fire
overview: A short film based on the poem of the same name. A woman relives the ardent and haunting memories of a lost love that she wants to forget.

title: Marilyn's Dark Paradise
overview: An adventurous time traveler befriends Marilyn Monroe and struggles with adhering to the rigid rules of time travel.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: The Art of Walking
overview: Years after the loss of her best friend, Lorena returns to her hometown searching for meaning in her life and emotions.

title: See the Sea
overview: As a result of a series of unexpected coincidences, one of the three closet-sitters gets out from his natural environment, but in his absence longing for the friends starts to crystalize…

title: Also Fine
overview: Used to keeping quiet, Wei shuts out his parents' absurd antics behind closed doors. Neglected at home, Hsuan travels north by herself and stumbles into Wei's life. Taipei's starry nights, planes piercing the sky... these overlooked everyday moments in the city turn into a ray of light for them against an ambiguous future.

title: The Visitor
overview: After receiving a strange phone call late at night, a young man is visited by a mysterious stranger who claims to know something that he has forgotten.

title: The Last Sun
overview: In a world where the sun has vanished, Gibraltar holds the last ray of light. Lena, a scientist, confronts her past and a rival as she fights to protect humanity's only remaining hope.

title: Ciclo de Lavado
overview: Marina and Lucía, two flatmates, discover a unique feature of their new washing machine.

title: Poirot is a teenage girl and they killed her boyfriend
overview: June 1985. When Veronica discovers her boyfriend's dead body in the pool after a high school house party, she decides to become a detective on par with Hercule Poirot and find out who the killer was.

title: Mugre
overview: A young woman, determined to clean her late father's filthy apartment, discovers that no matter how hard she tries, the grime always comes back.

title: Sambhavna: A Story of Possibility, Healing, and Hope
overview: Forty years after the Bhopal tragedy, one of the worst industrial disasters in history, thousands of people are still living with the devastating effects of chemical contamination.

title: Now What?
overview: An intimate portrait of a relationship suspended in time - a breath held before the plunge. Alice and Paul have exhausted words; the silence between them resonates with everything unspoken. They stand at the edge of something irreversible, knowing change must come, yet unsure if they're brave enough to face it.

title: First Kiss
overview: What happens when a memory from your youth becomes a journey across an ocean? Forty years after sharing her first kiss with a young man in France, Lena returns to the place where it happened - this time determined to find him.

title: Amoris
overview: Amarus is a travelling salesman of sorts in a world where some choose to carry the whispers of their souls in handcrafted wooden boxes. Loosely inspired by Plato's 3 phases of love (Scala Amoris), we follow Amarus through various flashes of romance, in a metaphorical tale about vulnerability, closure, and self-revelation. Blurring the lines of music video and cinema, AMORIS spotlights the core of what's most important to both...storytelling.

title: Gambit
overview: Leonard, a conflicted introvert, has been convinced by his brother Tyler to jointly rob a jewellery store. Leonard, unbeknownst to Tyler, has been persuaded by his lover, Olivia, to take the money and run. In this crime drama, Leonard will have to decide what his final move will be.

title: Switch
overview: A young woman tries to leave her old life behind. Dark forces pursue her, and she experiences a moral awakening.

title: Silent Connections
overview: On a rainy afternoon in Mexico City, Gonzalo, a young man from Sonora, burdened by grief and distance, takes refuge on a park bench. There he meets Yolitzli, a deaf young woman from Oaxaca. Through gestures, silence, and falling rain, an unexpected bond emerges between them, transforming the way they communicate and reminding him that true listening reaches far beyond the ears.

title: Siesta
overview: Conchita, a young woman unable to escape her constant exhaustion, embarks on a journey between dream and reality through a deserted Granada to confront herself and finish the Cruz de Mayo in time for the festivities.

title: sometimes, I...
overview: Upcoming short film directed and written by Jamie Cooke

title: The Forbidden Aunt
overview: An actress documents her enigmatic Serbian aunt's story, revealing family secrets and personal history in a dark comedy exploring female trauma across generations.

title: Aftermath
overview: A massacre survivor and a filmmaker form an unlikely bond as they slip down the rabbit hole of paranoia, in a desperate search for solace and truth.

title: Every Time I See A Cock I Go Funny
overview: When a Yorkshire coal miner's trousers get stolen, a scandal erupts that sinks the colliery into turmoil, exposing the hypocritical, horny heart of postwar British pride and masculinity.

title: Devilwoman
overview: A film director try to make a good film but then realized the arrangement from producer was awful, the leading actress is not what he wished, even the important prop on set was disappeared. Director wants to make arts but he only feels the pressure from the acclaimed executive producer KIN GEN HAO. Then devilwoman appears, she met someone she loves, but when everything seem so beautiful, she realized there's a big mistake.

overview: A young woman studying far from home, faces heartbreak, she begins to feel lost in life.  She decides go back to home in the countryside make her know what is true love

overview: A farmer's belly propels him into an extraordinary world, turning Homo Sapiens to Homo Umbilicus.

title: Forever Loved 2: Trina's Special Day
overview: A surprise birthday party for Trina unravels into a series of comedic mishaps and heartfelt revelations, ultimately strengthening the bonds of family and friendship.

title: Forza on the Run
overview: Heavy Weekend 02: The French police have put the illegal drift racers of Paris on final notice, so they've took off on the run across the border into Belgium. Hanrahan rides along with the crew as they dodge police and takeover Brussels.

title: The Informant
overview: Eighty-two-year-old Juris Kalniņš has found his name in the archives of the Committee for State Security of the Latvian SSR, where he is identified as an informant. Both during the Soviet era and today, he remains an uncompromising free thinker who has devoted most of his life to photographing people and documenting the spirit of the times. With the camera now turned towards Juris, he is ready to delve into his past to understand how his name could have ended up on a KGB file. What makes a person an informant – a piece of paper, mere suspicion, the opinions of others, or one’s own actions?

title: Beautiful Pain
overview: Niken (Raihaanun), a single mother going through a divorce from Dirga (Baim Wong), must find a job so she can gain custody of her child and support herself. Niken then lands a role in a movie and becomes popular. However, at the same time, she faces problems with the film crew and with her ex-husband, who is trying to take custody of their child away from her.

title: Flamin­go Flamenco
overview: The Fuente de Piedra lagoon in Spain is home to one of the largest flocks of flamingos in Europe. Once a year, the adolescent birds perform a dance that looks like... flamenco! But when the flock is attacked by hateful podencos (wild dogs) our heroine Rosie, a fun, dance crazy flamingo, loses her beloved sister and the flamenco is cancelled henceforth. She grows up a shadow of her former self, robbed of her sisters love and the joy of dance. One day she meets Carlos, an exuberant lizard, who encourages her to dance once more - rekindling her inner flame. Over time, she transforms back into her old confident self, before leading her flock to face down the podencos and dance once more.

title: Forza
overview: Bima, a 13 year old boy who lives in the slums of Bali, dreams of becoming a professional football player in order to get out of poverty and to provide for his beloved family. When Bima meets Marco, a professional football player from Bali Royal FC who is at the brink of retirement from his football career, Bima’s once unachievable dream becomes a reality because he was given a rare chance to trial with the AC Milan Youth Team in Italy.

title: Wonder Beast
overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

title: Pirunduk
overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime

title: Kingdom of Crooked Mirrors
overview: Olya lives with her grandmother, who loves to tell her magical stories. Her parents are always busy and are rarely at home. The girl quarrels with her family and accidentally ends up in the mirror kingdom from her grandmother's stories, where she meets her reflection - Yalo. In this world, all people are too absorbed in mirrors, because in them they see ideal versions of themselves. These magic mirrors were invented by Korshun to subjugate the entire kingdom to his power, and Olya will have to believe in a miracle and save the fairy-tale world.

title: Pulsatrix
overview: Haunted by the early loss of her son, Neta struggles to find peace while working as a housekeeper on a remote farm with her husband, Nelson. When the landowners arrive for the weekend, her buried pain is reawakened and ignites a spiral of revenge, leading to an inevitable confrontation between grief, power, and justice.

title: Turnbuckle
overview: A small-town errand runner for a local drug producer faces one insurmountable task after another over 24 hours.

title: EESHAN - THE PROTECTOR
overview: An upcoming Indian feature film currently in development.  The project approaches myth and futurism with restraint, exploring responsibility, balance, and human choice without spectacle or exposition.

title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
overview: There are places that are meant to be just a stopover. But there are also places that make you wish you’d never come.

title: A Tale of Lost Times
overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

title: EVERY LIFE
overview: A 15-year-old boy wakes up in a mysterious attic and meets an entity who tells him the horrifying truth about the universe.

title: Falling White Leaves
overview: Thomas and Félix, a father and son long estranged, reunite for a picturesque photographic journey through the south of Puerto Rico, embarking on an adventure that leads them to an unexpected new descendant of their family.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Blue Heron
overview: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

title: Pixie. The New Beginning
overview: New in town, eleven-year-old Hania is bullied for believing in pixies. She makes friends with the outsider Michał and a real pixie, Sindri, on a quest to prove their existence. Their journey helps Hania face new beginnings and understand the power of friendship.

title: Les Enfants Iront Bien
overview: Aaron is at the beginning of his adult life and is struggling with the responsibilities that come with it. He is still searching for his place in the world, while also doing his best to ensure that his little brother James grows up in the best possible circumstances.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: Hitch
overview: A woman encounters a hitchhiker in the middle of the night while driving. From there, things spiral into absurdity, blurring the lines between what's real -and what isn't.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: The River Train
overview: Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote Argentinian village where he studies the Malambo, a folk dance full of bravura. He is an excellent dancer, but Milo’s only desire is to escape the countryside on a train for the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

title: Untitled A24 Horror Film
overview: A bachelor party spirals into terror.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: Convince Me
